map.会比纯文本大不少——每个 token 都被包进 span 标签，代码量越大、语言: It is noticeably larger than plain text, since every token is wrapped in a span tag; the more code and the finer the language rules, the higher the tag overhead. To keep the size down you can highlight only key lines, or switch to runtime highlighting to keep the HTML lean, at the cost of a JS dependency and a first-paint flash.
